title: First band job at Artesian Hall with the Morgans
summary: He is sent to substitute at Artesian Hall for the Morgan band, his first band job; the Morgans were mostly ear players.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Do you remember any of your other early jobs then, the very first ones after that?

Well, the first job I played with a band. I, Zeldon Morgan, was playing over at the Artesian Hall one night and the client up there, Adolfo was playing over at the Artesian Hall one night and the first one night was playing with him. For some reason he couldn't so he asked me to go over there. He sent me over there. That was my first job with a band. And well I, I was pretty fair there. Just playing by ear, you know.
Did the Morgan band, the Sam and Isaiah both, did they use music ever much or did they mostly just ear players?
Mostly, yeah. They, they, they, they'd get to, they'd get the music of a number and run over until they get it in the head and then put it aside.
